headline: Linear allows immediate public distribution of OAuth apps with no mandatory verification or review process.
summary: Developers can build, test, and distribute Linear OAuth applications instantly by toggling a setting from private to public. While an official Integration Directory exists, submission is completely optional. For AI agents, Linear supports a dedicated application actor mode (actor=app) requiring workspace admin consent.

oauth.pkce: Natively supported and recommended for response_type=code using S256 or plain methods, making the client_secret optional for token exchange and refresh.
oauth.refresh_tokens: Access tokens expire after 24 hours. Refreshing tokens performs rotation, issuing new access and refresh tokens. A 30-minute grace period allows replaying failed refresh requests during network drops.
oauth.redirect_uri_rules: Redirect URIs must match exactly in both the authorization request and the application settings. http://localhost is permitted for local development.
oauth.scopes: Automatically includes 'read'. 'write' provides full access, with granular options available. Specialized bot scopes 'app:mentionable' and 'app:assignable' are available when using actor=app.

steps.title: Create Management Workspace
steps.detail: Create a dedicated Linear workspace solely for managing the OAuth application so all admins share credential access.

steps.title: Register Application
steps.detail: Navigate to Settings > Administration > API to register the OAuth client and specify exact redirect URIs.

steps.title: Implement OAuth PKCE Flow
steps.detail: Build the authorization flow using the authorize endpoint and PKCE code challenges.

steps.title: Build Agent API Logic
steps.detail: Develop GraphQL queries and mutations respecting rate limits and query complexity scores.

steps.title: Toggle Public Distribution
steps.detail: Switch the application distribution setting from private to public in the application manifest or settings.

requirements.text: The OAuth app name (client_name) must be between 2 and 80 characters, cannot contain the word 'Linear', and cannot use protocol prefixes like http:// or https://.
Installing an app with actor=app (application mode) mandates Linear workspace admin approval.
Linear requires exact string matching for redirect URIs between the app configuration and authorization requests.

gotchas.text: Linear does not publish standard OAuth/OIDC discovery metadata at its root domain.
Using actor=app with the 'admin' scope is strictly restricted and will be automatically rejected.
Linear provides a 30-minute grace period on refresh tokens, allowing developers to safely replay refresh requests if a network dropout occurs during token rotation.
Individual GraphQL queries exceeding 10,000 complexity points will be immediately rejected regardless of hourly quotas.

permissions.action: Read connected user's issues and workspace data
permissions.review_impact: Default scope. No extra review required. Delegated user mode requires only individual user consent.

permissions.action: Create and update issues, comments, and projects
permissions.review_impact: No extra review required. Delegated user mode requires only individual user consent.

permissions.action: Act autonomously as an AI agent rather than a specific user
permissions.review_impact: Requires passing actor=app during authorization. Triggers mandatory workspace admin consent upon installation. Agents do not consume paid billable seats.

blockers.issue: Enterprise workspace owners restrict third-party OAuth app installations.
blockers.how_to_proceed: The requesting user must petition their internal workspace administrators to approve the application or lift the restriction.

blockers.issue: Integration Directory submission rejected for being a hobby project or 'vibe-coded' script.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Skip the directory. Directory listing is optional and strictly for marketing. You can still distribute the app publicly to any external user via standard OAuth authorization URLs.

agent_can: Implement PKCE code challenge generation and token exchange logic.
Draft robust retry logic to handle the 30-minute refresh token grace period.
Monitor and parse X-RateLimit-Requests and X-RateLimit-Complexity headers to throttle API calls.
you_must: Set up a dedicated Linear workspace for app ownership to prevent credential lock-in to a single user account.
Ensure the application name complies with trademark rules by omitting the word 'Linear'.
Manually toggle the app distribution setting to 'public' to allow external installs.

key_claims.text: The authorize endpoint is live and responding at https://linear.app/oauth/authorize.
The Linear developer portal is publicly accessible at https://linear.app/developers.
No mandatory third-party security assessment or domain verification is required to make an OAuth app public.
Rate limits are set to 5,000 requests and 2,000,000 complexity points per hour per user/app combination.

open_questions: Does Linear plan to enforce API usage limits or directory requirements on public unlisted apps in the future?
What is the exact internal review turnaround time for apps that do opt into the Integration Directory?
